content: The topic of maternal satisfaction with the induction of labor was addressed, highlighting that some caregivers expressed dissatisfaction with the care provided during this process. The World Health Organization (WHO) has issued 36 recommendations regarding the induction of labor at or beyond term, which are detailed in Annex 3 of their guidelines. A summary and management of declared interests from members of the Guideline Development Group (GDG) and reviewers were also provided.
